SELECT  "t0"."code" AS "code",
( ts_headline(CAST('simple' AS regconfig), "t0"."description", websearch_to_tsquery(CAST('simple' AS regconfig), :q), 'StartSel=<mark>, StopSel=</mark>, MaxWords=20, MinWords=5, MaxFragments=99, FragmentDelimiter=<hr/>') ) AS "probe",
"t0"."id" AS "pkey"
 FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS t0
WHERE ("t0"."description" @@ websearch_to_tsquery(CAST('simple' AS regconfig),:q)) AND ("t0"."__del_ts" IS NULL)
